Meta.title: EuroEdge — European equity perpetuals (testnet)
Meta.description: European stocks. Perpetual. Fairly priced 24/7. Public testnet with play money.

Banner.text: Play money only — Test USDC has no value. No investment advice. Outside exchange hours, prices are model estimates.

Footer.riskWarning: Perpetual futures are complex leveraged products. On this testnet all funds are play money and have no value.

windowHint.C: All venues closed; price from the model
windowHint.D: Weekend or holiday; price from the model with a widening band

Terminal.noLiveSource: No live source — fair value held, band widening
Terminal.chartLabel: Mark price, fair value and fair-value band
Terminal.chartDescription: Line chart of the mark price with the fair value and its confidence band over the last two hours.
Terminal.loginToTrade: Log in to trade with play money.
Terminal.networkError: The order could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

reject.not-genesis: The testnet is starting up. Try again in a moment.
reject.no-market-data: No price yet. Try again in a moment.
reject.unknown-account: Your account has no funds yet.
reject.reduce-only: Only reducing orders are allowed for this position.
reject.reduce-only-window: Only reducing orders are allowed in this window.
reject.price-limit: The price is too far from the index right now.
reject.min-notional: Below the minimum order value of 10 USDC.
reject.insufficient-margin: Not enough margin for this size at the current leverage cap.
reject.no-position: There is no position to close.
reject.circuit-breaker: A circuit breaker is active: only reducing orders are allowed right now.
reject.not-marketable: The price has not reached your limit.
reject.too-many-orders: Too many open orders. Cancel some first.
reject.would-trigger: The trigger would already be reached at the current mark.
reject.house-one-sided: The house is not taking new positions on this side right now. The other side and reducing orders work.
reject.house-inventory: The house position limit is reached: only reducing orders right now.
reject.house-loss-limit: The house's daily loss limit is reached: only reducing orders until the next day (UTC).
reject.would-take: Post-only: this limit would trade at once, so it was not placed.
reject.invalid-order: This combination of order options is not allowed.
reject.market-frozen: This market is paused for a corporate action (e.g. a split). Trading resumes shortly.
reject.oi-cap: Open interest in this market is at its cap: only reducing orders for now.
reject.snap-outside-band: The opening price jumped outside the last band: only reducing orders for 5 minutes.

Terminal.devLoginHint: Development login: no wallet needed. You get 10,000 Test USDC with no value.

breakerEffect.degraded: Degraded: no new positions, wider spreads

Terminal.limitAccepted: Limit order placed at {price}. It fills when the price reaches it.
Terminal.cancelFailed: The order could not be cancelled.
Terminal.signInHint: Email, Google or your own wallet. New users get a wallet automatically and 10,000 Test USDC with no value.
